title: Sitidiyo
intro: Radiyo zose ziri kuri uru rubuga. Buri sitidiyo ivuga mu rurimi rumwe, kandi ururimi umuntu ahisemo ni rwo rugena sitidiyo yumva.

actions.label: Ibikorwa kuri {{name}}
actions.lastActive: Nibura sitidiyo imwe igomba guhora iri ku murongo

create.title: Sitidiyo nshya
create.languageHint: Sitidiyo izavuga muri uru rurimi. Ntibizashoboka kuruhindura nyuma.
create.ownerHint: Si ngombwa. Ushobora no kongeramo abantu nyuma mu igenamiterere rya sitidiyo.
create.permanentHint: Sitidiyo ikoresha imiterere y’ijwi y’urubuga (bitrate, sample rate, channels) kugira ngo indirimbo n’ibiganiro bya live bigende neza. Ububiko bwayo n’ibyangombwa bya encoder bihita bishyirwaho.
create.done: {{name}} iri ku murongo. Shyiramo indirimbo kandi utange ibyangombwa bya encoder kugira ngo utangire gutambutsa.
create.noneAvailable: Buri rurimi rwemewe rusanzwe rufite sitidiyo.
create.pending: {{name}} yashyizweho. Seriveri ya radiyo ntirabyemeza; ijya ku murongo mu minota 5.

deactivate.title: Uhagarika {{name}}?
deactivate.body: Radiyo ihita iva ku murongo kandi abayumva bakimurirwa kuri sitidiyo y’ibanze. Abanyamuryango ntibazongera kuyigeraho kugeza yongeye gukoreshwa. Indirimbo, abanyamuryango n’imibare biragumaho.
deactivate.pending: {{name}} yahagaritswe. Seriveri ya radiyo ntirabyemeza; iva ku murongo mu minota 5.

activate.title: Wongera gukoresha {{name}}?
activate.body: Radiyo ihita isubira ku murongo ifite indirimbo, abanyamuryango n’igenamiterere yari isanganywe.
activate.pending: {{name}} yongeye gukoreshwa. Seriveri ya radiyo ntirabyemeza; ijya ku murongo mu minota 5.
